Kerala, Tamil Nadu dispute Mullaperiyar dam water level

Kerala has informed the Mullaperiyar dam supervisory committee that 35 lakh people remain under threat, while Tamil Nadu is seeking to raise the water level to 152 feet. The water level in the dam currently stands at 112.25 feet. This dispute highlights ongoing tensions over water management and safety concerns related to the dam.
